description: This file defines the LoggerLocationInfo class which encapsulates caller location information such as file name, line number, class, and method name, typically used for logging purposes within the log4php framework.

classes.name: LoggerLocationInfo
classes.description: A class that stores and retrieves caller location details such as file name, line number, class name, and method name for logging purposes.

methods.name: LoggerLocationInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on a backtrace array and optionally a fully qualified class name, extracting caller location info.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the caller, or a placeholder if not available.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the caller, or a placeholder if not available.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the line number of the caller, or a placeholder if not available.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the method name of the caller, or a placeholder if not available.
